platform: OpenEduCat, an Odoo-based education ERP; browser-based, managed cloud, self-hosted or hybrid, with native iOS and Android apps.

distinctive_features.feature: LGPL-3 Community Edition supports code inspection, modification, and self-hosting.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions can avoid per-student licensing and retain control over deployment and customization.

distinctive_features.feature: Odoo-based shared data model combines academic, finance, HR, and campus records.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: A common database can reduce duplicate records and fragmented institutional systems.

distinctive_features.feature: Deployment choices include managed cloud, on-premise, and hybrid.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions can choose hosting based on operational capacity and data-residency needs.

distinctive_features.feature: Enterprise supports CBCS, OBE, CO–PO attainment, thesis management, convocation, and placements.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: These workflows address higher-education requirements that are uncommon in school-first ERPs.

distinctive_features.feature: AI tools can connect to cloud providers or self-hosted Llama and Mistral endpoints.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions have flexibility in model selection and potential data-handling arrangements.

distinctive_features.feature: Enterprise exam tools include OMR scanning, multiple exam versions, and proctoring.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: These tools support larger or more operationally complex assessment programs.

distinctive_features.feature: Enterprise No Code Studio provides drag-and-drop apps, forms, workflows, and reports.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Administrators can adapt processes without building every change through custom code.

distinctive_features.feature: Indian fee collection integrates Razorpay with UPI and ledger reconciliation.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: It connects familiar local payment methods to student fee records.

distinctive_features.feature: LTI 1.3, SCORM, and xAPI support learning integrations.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions can connect external learning content and exchange learning data.

weaknesses.issue: Reviewers report a learning curve, difficult setup, and technical issues.
Some reviewers report insufficient support and documentation, especially for non-technical integrations.
Users describe too many menus and icons, terminology barriers, and a dated student profile.
Reviewers say grading-period and multi-teacher workflows can be cumbersome.
Feedback cites limited out-of-box customization and occasional performance slowdowns.
Public documentation does not confirm ready-made Indian statutory exports such as UDISE+ or AISHE.
Public documentation does not substantiate Tally, GST-specific invoicing, or DPDP readiness.
Enterprise modules, mobile apps, hosting, and implementation can add costs; final quotes require configuration.

ai_features: At-risk alerts and predictive performance or enrollment insights
Model-agnostic connections to OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and Mistral
AI chat assistant and enhanced search are listed by G2 but not independently verified
pricing_model_summary: Community Edition is free and LGPL-3. Enterprise starts at $79 per module annually; user packs, deployment, separately priced mobile apps, and implementation affect total cost. No public INR price.
biggest_strategic_gap: India-specific statutory reporting and compliance are not clearly documented, while reviews also cite setup complexity, usability friction, and support gaps.
